shortDescription: Mexico's economy likely expanded 3.7% in September from the same month a year earlier, a preliminary estimate from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Tuesday.Compared with the previous month, activity was likely slightly up 0.1%, the agency added.

children: Mexico's economy likely expanded 3.7% in September from the same month a year earlier, a preliminary estimate from national statistics agency INEGI showed on Tuesday.
